note: The Financial Institutions (Credit Reference Bureau) Regulations, 2022, regulation 24(2)(a): a credit report may not include information on a debt's repayment five years after it's fully paid. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: The Financial Institutions (Credit Reference Bureau) Regulations, 2022 (Statutory Instrument 2022 No. 106, Uganda Gazette)
sources.said: information regarding the repayment of any debt five years after the obligation has been fully paid or has been extinguished by any other procedure except writing-off;
